notes:
SPIN / madewithspin.com (Shopify). Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi) for collections.json/products.json/sitemap, Playwright/CDP to confirm the live rendered grid on /collections/outlet and /collections/stock-sale (neither shows the theme's usual 'product-facet' count banner via plain HTTP, but scrolled Playwright rendering confirmed both are genuine flat product grids spanning many categories - planters, X-mas ornaments, storage boxes, etc. for Outlet - not editorial pages). Discovery: checked mobile-nav drawer, desktop header (no 'Clearance'/'Outlet'/'Sale' item in the primary menu - Outlet and Stock Sale are unlinked/orphaned from current nav but both are live, indexed, 200-OK, actively-updated collections per collections.json updated_at and the collections sitemap), footer (no match), and collections.json (236 collections, single page, no other clearance-style handles found - no 'final-sale', 'last-chance', 'end-of-line', or 'discontinued' handles exist on this store). collections.json's own products_count is inflated vs an exhaustive /products.json?limit=250 (paginated) enumeration for both rows below - trusted the exhaustive enumeration per project convention (Outlet: 66 reported vs 48 exhaustive; Stock Sale: 21 reported vs 19 exhaustive). Checked overlap between the two: only 1 shared product ID out of 48+19, confirming genuinely distinct listings, not aliases of each other. Sale-vs-Clearance reasoning: 'Outlet' is an explicit target term (no ambiguity). 'Stock Sale' contains the word 'Sale', which the merge step's blind pattern would force-flag - I independently checked the page for on-page copy describing permanence (none found: no meta description, no heading, no body_html on the collection object) but the title itself ('Stock Sale', i.e. clearing existing/excess stock) reads as outlet-style rather than a seasonal % -off campaign, and it is a distinct, non-overlapping product set from Outlet, not a temporary campaign page layered over the whole catalog - recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per brief guidance since outlet-style permanence could not be confirmed from on-page text alone.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 1 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
